title: Mazatecan languages — Grokipedia
text: January 14, 2026 - Highland Mazatec varieties, spoken in the Sierra Mazateca highlands of northern Oaxaca and southern Puebla states in Mexico, form the demographic and linguistic core of the Mazatecan branch of the Popolocan subgroup within the Otomanguean family. These varieties are distinguished by their elevated terrain habitat, contrasting with lowland forms, and exhibit a dialect continuum with varying degrees of mutual intelligibility.
